items.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Could Still Be Undervalued As AI Hopes Swing
items.summary: Datadog shares have swung sharply in recent months, and the question now is whether the current US$174.60 price can still be explained by the cash the business is expected to generate. With sentiment pulled around by AI excitement and sector-wide worries, the key issue is how that market mood lines up with the company’s underlying cash flows. Over the past 3 years, Datadog has delivered a total share price gain of 68.5%, which puts real pressure on its cash flows to justify how far the stock...

items.title: Datadog Just Dropped 34% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 34% in a week, first in a software selloff that also hit ServiceNow and Cloudflare, then on a flat fourth-quarter outlook. That outlook assumes Datadog’s largest customer, an AI company, pays only its minimum; growth from everyone else is guided to the low to mid-30s.

items.title: Datadog Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Both Rise Y/Y
items.summary: DDOG's Q3 EPS rises 47.3% and revenues climb 35.2%, beating estimates as AI adoption widens. Q4 guidance assumes its largest customer's minimum commitment.

items.title: DDOG Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Customer Renewals
items.summary: Datadog's Q3 revenues surge 35%, with adjusted EPS beating estimates, but AI customer discounts and cautious Q4 guidance temper its growth outlook.

items.title: Needham’s $300 Target Says Datadog’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock is down 36% from its October high, most recently after a fourth-quarter outlook that showed flat revenue from the third quarter. Needham repeated its Buy rating and $300 target on Wednesday, 59% above the close and near the $296 consensus target.
